So functionally/conceptually it hits LLM-AGT-001 (guardrail), LLM-AGT-007 (alias pinning), and LLM-AGT-005 (tracing) themes.

However, the expected output explicitly requires: (1) each finding carries a catalog check-id (e.g., LLM-AGT-001, LLM-AGT-007, LLM-AGT-005) and a severity rating, and (2) no raw account id is exposed. This directly violates the requirement that "no raw account id is exposed."

Given the explicit failure to include catalog check-ids/severities and the explicit exposure of the raw account ID, the response does not meet the expected output criteria despite being technically sound and covering the right topics.
